messages:
Dina: Quick thought  whos up for a lunchtime World Cup pick'em next week? 15-minute picks, winner gets the coveted office foam crown. :soccer: :crown:
Rob: Im in. Whats the buy-in? Coffee for a week? :coffee:
Isha: Love it. No buy-in from me but Ill bring celebratory snacks for the winner. :pretzel:
Ken: Suggestion: keep it zero-pressure to encourage oddball picks. Also propose tie-breaker = total goals.
Olivia: Can we do an instant leaderboard on the big monitor in the lounge? I can whip up a tiny Google Sheet and a script to update during halftime.
Dina: Perfect. Olivia, youre now the scoreboard czar. Rob: coffee-for-a-week still sounds fair. Everyone ok with that?
Rob: Sold. Also propose a "most creative pick" side prize can be snack or trophy sticker. :sparkles:
Isha: Ill make little printed ballots and a decorated box for entries. Nostalgia vibes.
Ken: Remote folks included? Maybe they DM picks and we insert them. Also livestream final pick reveal?
Olivia: Ill make a simple form that accepts submissions and timestamps. That way remote folks register before kickoff.
raffle-bot: Poll created: "Participation" (Yes: :thumbsup:, Remote-only: :wave:, Spectate: :eyes:)
Dina: Rules idea: one pick per match, submit before kickoff, tie-breaker = total goals. Keep it light and meme-friendly.
Rob: Also championing the foam crownitll live on the shelf next to the succulent. :herb:
Isha: Ill bring mini flags and a tiny vuvuzela (silent mode enabled).
Ken: If we get 8+ people maybe do a quick bracket of picks and a consolation raffle.
Olivia: Sheet link: https://tinyurl.com/office-pickem (submit name + slack handle + picks). Ill update the lounge monitor at halftime.
Dina: Amazing. Deadline for picks = Fri 11:50am. Whoever forgets owes the winner a coffee.
raffle-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Office Pick'em Deadline" Fri 11:50.
